parameters.name: Amount
parameters.description: The number of instances to create. Valid values: 1 to 100.

parameters.name: AutoInstallCloudAssistant
parameters.description: Specifies whether to automatically install the Cloud Assistant client on the instance.

parameters.name: AutoReleaseTime
parameters.description:
The automatic release time of the pay-as-you-go instance. Specify the time in the [ISO 8601](~~25696~~) standard in the `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ` format. The time must be in UTC.

- If the value of seconds (`ss`) is not `00`, the time is automatically set to the start of the current minute (`mm`).

- The earliest release time is one hour after the current time.

parameters.name: AutoRenew
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to enable auto-renewal. Valid values:

- **true**: enables auto-renewal.
- **false**: does not enable auto-renewal. (Default)

>This parameter is invalid for pay-as-you-go instances.

parameters.name: AutoUseCoupon
parameters.description: Specifies whether to use coupons. Default value: true (AutoUseCoupon=true).

parameters.name: BillingCycle
parameters.description:
The billing cycle for instance compute resources. Only instance-level pay-as-you-go is supported. Valid values:

- **Day**: daily billing.

- **Month**: monthly billing.

parameters.name: Carrier
parameters.description:
The carrier.
>This parameter is required for region-level scheduling.</br>
>For node-level scheduling, if a node has multiple carriers and you do not specify a carrier, instances are created for each carrier on the node. For example, if a node has both China Mobile and China Unicom carriers, instances with two ISPs are created.</br>You can call [DescribeRegionIsps](~~2637461~~) to query the carrier information of a node.

parameters.name: CloudAssistantRegion
parameters.description: The region for Cloud Assistant access. Valid values: cn-zhangjiakou (Zhangjiakou) and ap-southeast-1 (Singapore).

parameters.name: DataDisk
parameters.description: The data cloud disk specifications.

sub_parameters.name: Category
sub_parameters.description:
The disk category. Valid values:
- **cloud_efficiency**: ultra cloud disk
- **cloud_ssd**: all-flash cloud disk
- **local_hdd**: local HDD
- **local_ssd**: local SSD

sub_parameters.name: Encrypted
sub_parameters.description:
Specifies whether to encrypt the cloud disk. Valid values:

- true: encrypts the cloud disk.

- false (default): does not encrypt the cloud disk.

sub_parameters.name: KMSKeyId
sub_parameters.description:
The ID of the KMS key used by the cloud disk. Valid values:

- true: encrypts the cloud disk.

- false (default): does not encrypt the cloud disk.

> If Encrypted is set to true and KMSKeyId is empty, the default service key is used.

sub_parameters.name: Size
sub_parameters.description: The size of the data cloud disk. Unit: GiB.

parameters.name: DeletionProtection
parameters.description:
The release protection property of the instance. Specifies whether the instance can be released from the console or by calling an API operation. Valid values: 

-  true: Enables instance release protection.
-  false: Disables instance release protection.

Default value: false.

> This property applies only to pay-as-you-go instances and can only restrict manual release operations. It does not take effect on system-initiated release operations.

parameters.name: DeploymentSetId
parameters.description: The deployment set ID.

parameters.name: EnsRegionId
parameters.description:
The node ID.

> This parameter is required for node-level scheduling and is invalid for region-level scheduling.

parameters.name: HostName
parameters.description: The hostname.

parameters.name: ImageId
parameters.description: The image ID. This parameter cannot be specified for ARM-based instances. This parameter is required for other instance types.

parameters.name: InstanceChargeStrategy
parameters.description:
The instance billing strategy. Valid values:

- **instance**: instance-level billing.
- If not specified, the default is user-level billing.

parameters.name: InstanceChargeType
parameters.description:
The billing method of the instance. Valid values:
- **PrePaid**: subscription.
- **PostPaid**: pay-as-you-go.

parameters.name: InstanceName
parameters.description:
The instance name. The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length and must start with a letter or Chinese character. It cannot start with `http://` or `https://`. It can contain Chinese characters, letters, digits, colons (:), underscores (_), periods (.), or hyphens (-).

Default value: the InstanceId of the instance.

parameters.name: InstanceType
parameters.description: The instance type.

parameters.name: InternetChargeType
parameters.description:
Billable methods for bandwidth. Valid values:
- **BandwidthByDay**: daily peak bandwidth
- **95BandwidthByMonth**: monthly 95th percentile bandwidth

> You can select a billing method only for the first purchase. Subsequent purchases use the billing method selected during the first purchase by default.

parameters.name: InternetMaxBandwidthOut
parameters.description: The maximum public bandwidth. If the value of this parameter is greater than 0, a public IP address is automatically assigned to the instance.

parameters.name: IpType
parameters.description:
The IP type. Valid values:

- **ipv4** (default): IPv4.

- **ipv6**: IPv6.

- **ipv4Andipv6**: IPv4 and IPv6 (single stack).
- **ipv4Withipv6**: IPv4 and IPv6 (dual-stack).

parameters.name: Ipv6AddressCount
parameters.description: The number of randomly generated IPv6 addresses to assign to the primary ENI of the private network.

parameters.name: KeyPairName
parameters.description:
The key pair name.
> Specify at least one of **Password**, **KeyPairName**, and **PasswordInherit**.

parameters.name: LaunchTemplateId
parameters.description: The ID of the instance launch template.

parameters.name: LaunchTemplateName
parameters.description: The name of the instance launch template.

parameters.name: LaunchTemplateVersion
parameters.description: The version of the instance launch template.

parameters.name: NetDistrictCode
parameters.description:
The region code.
>This parameter is required for region-level scheduling and is invalid for node-level scheduling.

parameters.name: NetWorkId
parameters.description:
The network ID.

>This parameter can only be used for node-level scheduling. An error is returned if this parameter is specified for region-level scheduling. If you do not specify vSwitch information, only the validity of the network ID is verified. The actual resource creation does not use this network ID.

parameters.name: Password
parameters.description:
The instance password.

> Specify at least one of **Password**, **KeyPairName**, and **PasswordInherit**.

parameters.name: PasswordInherit
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to use the preset password of the image. Valid values:

- **true**: uses the preset password.
- **false**: does not use the preset password.

> Specify at least one of **Password**, **KeyPairName**, and **PasswordInherit**.

parameters.name: Period
parameters.description:
The duration of the purchased resource.

- If **PeriodUnit** is set to **Day**, **Period** can only be set to **3**.

- If **PeriodUnit** is set to **Month**, **Period** can be set to **1-9** or **12**.

parameters.name: PeriodUnit
parameters.description:
The unit of the purchase duration. Valid values:
- **Month** (default): monthly purchase.
- **Day**: daily purchase.

parameters.name: PrivateIpAddress
parameters.description:
The private IP address.
>This parameter can only be used for node-level scheduling. An error is returned if this parameter is specified for region-level scheduling.
If a private IP address is specified, the number of instances can only be 1. The private IP address takes effect only when both the private IP address and vSwitch ID are specified.

parameters.name: PublicIpIdentification
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to enable public IP identification. Valid values:

- true: enables public IP identification.

- false: does not enable public IP identification.

Default value: true.

parameters.name: ScheduleAreaLevel
parameters.description:
The scheduling level. Use this parameter to specify node-level or region-level scheduling. Valid values:

- **Big**: major area
- **Middle**: province
- **Small**: city
- **Region**: node

parameters.name: SchedulingPriceStrategy
parameters.description:
The scheduling price strategy. Valid values:

- **PriceHighPriority**: high price first
- **PriceLowPriority**: low price first

parameters.name: SchedulingStrategy
parameters.description:
The scheduling strategy. Valid values:

- **Concentrate**: concentrated
- **Disperse**: dispersed

> For node-level scheduling, the value is **Concentrate**. For region-level scheduling, select a value based on your requirements.

parameters.name: SecurityId
parameters.description: The security group ID.

parameters.name: SpotDuration
parameters.description:
The protection period of the spot instance.

Unit: hours.

parameters.name: SpotStrategy
parameters.description:
The bidding policy for the pay-as-you-go instance. This parameter takes effect when the `InstanceChargeType` parameter is set to `PostPaid`. Valid values:

- NoSpot: a regular pay-as-you-go instance.
- SpotAsPriceGo: the system automatically bids at the current market price.

Default value: NoSpot.

parameters.name: SystemDisk
parameters.description: The system cloud disk specifications.

parameters.name: Tag
parameters.description: The tags that are bound to the instance.

sub_parameters.name: Value
sub_parameters.description: The tag value. The tag value cannot exceed 128 characters in length, and cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`, or contain `http://` or `https://`.

parameters.name: UniqueSuffix
parameters.description: Specifies whether to add sequential suffixes to **HostName** and **InstanceName**. The sequential suffixes start from 001 and cannot exceed 999.

parameters.name: UserData
parameters.description: The custom user data. Maximum size: 16 KB. You can pass in **UserData** information. **UserData** is Base64-encoded.

parameters.name: VSwitchId
parameters.description:
The vSwitch ID.

>This parameter can only be used for node-level scheduling. An error is returned if this parameter is specified for region-level scheduling.

parameters.name: VpdId
parameters.description: The VPD network ID.

parameters.name: VpdVSwitchIds
parameters.description: The list of VPD vSwitch IDs.
